Each world was once created. At the moment of creation its death was predefined. Father Time knows no pity. He watches the sand of time in his hourglass.

There's a point in the circle that is called Judgment Time. Ancient prophecies come true. The war is raging in multiple worlds. The Twilight of the Gods is impending. This is the time when the figures on the board change. The wheel turns. Those who was on top will fall. Those who were beneath will rise.

This is the fate of the world, predetermined by me, All-Mother, and by Father Time. Evil against Good. Evil rises over Good for just an instant but its fate is predetermined as well. It will fall. The Good will win, there is no other way. The sacrifice is great but day comes after night. This is the law that we established.

This is what happened last time. The ancient God of Darkness, now known as the Forgotten, has risen in all of his power. The worlds, possessed by legions of the Darkness, are burning. But the God of Light Sarn has also risen. He headed the resistance against the Darkness and destroyed the Forgotten once and for all. This was predetermined. Everything that's happened is just as we planned.

The new day has come. The circle is spinning once again.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
r155852.n: This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

t:
Many gods fell in the war with the Forgotten. Many worlds were destroyed. The survivors gathered in Eidos, where the primal images of creation are stored. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

I set to work, willing to create new worlds instead of what was destroyed. I created the twelve inner worlds first, in accordance with the number of Domains. Each of them should have been led by one of the survivors or newly born gods.

Sarn was one of the survivors, the greatest hero of the past war. He rightfully took the place of the God of Light.

Father Time and I chose two young goddesses among the new gods: Hirkalla and Hinanna. They were supposed to lead the Domains of Life and Death.

Only the Domain of the Forgotten, the Domain of Darkness remained unowned. None of the surviving gods wanted to take his place.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
r155861.n: This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

t:
Millions of years passed since the victory over Forgotten. The new god of the Domain of Darkness appeared. Hinanna, the younger sister, brought him to the door of Eidos. We accepted him and allowed him to take the vacant place. Each of the gods was supposed to played a role. The God of Darkness was accepted in our domain.

Hinanna's decision did not surprise me. She was a beautiful young goddess, stubborn, moody, gullible, and impulsive. She traveled across the worlds a lot, found her chosen ones among gods and mortals, toyed with their lives.

At some point, the mysterious God of Darkness attracted her attention. No one knew where he had come from. Some thought that he was mortal, who managed to become a god. This was extremely rare back then.

Hinanna showed him the way to Eidos, even though her sister Hirkalla pointed out that his intentions weren't pure. She thought that he was weird and scary so she decided to keep an eye on him.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
r155870.n: This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

t:
Hinanna was happy to see new faces. She and Nihaz, the God of Darkness, traveled between worlds, watched the fates of mortals, learned their secrets, discovered ancient artifacts of eons.

The power of the new God of Darkness grew by the year. Ancient monsters, who still remembered the Forgotten, accepted him. None of us had any objections. The Darkness was the natural opposite of the Light, and the Domain required a master. At that time Father Time and I considered him an ordinary "Master of Darkness," one of many. As other gods, he was supposed to start a war and fight the Light, and finally perish, like the Forgotten before him. This is what we thought, and never worried.

Only Hirkalla sensed that the circle has changed its spin. We considered her too young to rule the Domain of Death. She oversaw the Guardians of Ganzir, who ruled the post-mortal fates of all living in our worlds. Thanks to this, she saw that Nihaz was helping, teaching, and protecting mortals as best he could in his travels with Hinanna. She realized that their faith in him gave him even more power.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
r155877.n: This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
